]> 17/08/2026 7:09 A mostly sunny Monday at Perisher.

Happy Monday from Perisher! It's currently clear skies and -3 degrees, with today forecast to bring mostly sunny conditions, a top of 7 degrees, and northeasterly winds up to 17km/h.

38 lifts are scheduled to spin today, and the grooming team have prepared 57 runs across the resort for you to explore. Expect firm, fast conditions underfoot on hard-packed snow, which will likely soften as the day goes on.

Perisher would like to extend a warm welcome to all guests competing in the State Interschools this week. Best of luck with your races! To our other guests, please note that most Interschools races will be taking place on Front Valley and Centre Valley, so it's a great time to explore our other resort areas.

Have a great day out there!
